_note: G2 pre-registered 2026-11-17 before any result. Trend-following with volatility targeting, spot (long/flat) and USD-M perpetuals (long/short), with and without the risk-off dial from the feature screen. 4 configurations, no tuning. Do not edit after results exist.

data.spot: data/futures/{SYM}_spot_1h.parquet (close) for signals and spot execution
data.perp: data/futures/{SYM}_perp_1h.parquet (OHLC) for perp execution and marks
data.dial_features: built with research/feature_screen.py feature construction and its lagging rules

period.eligibility: a coin trades once it has 120 days of spot history and (perp variants) a listed perp

signal.score: mean over lookbacks of sign(close_t / close_{t-L} - 1); values in {-1, -1/3, 1/3, 1}
signal.timing: decided on daily closes up to 00:00 UTC; executed at the next hourly bar (perp: next 1h open; spot: next 1h close as proxy) plus slippage

sizing.vol_forecast: EWMA std of daily log returns, halflife 30 days, annualised x sqrt(365)
sizing.rebalance_band: trade a coin only if |target - current| >= max(0.02, 0.25 x |target|) of equity

risk_dial.formula: m = 1 - 0.25*[z(stablecoin_supply_chg_30d) < -1] - 0.25*[z(vix_level) > 1] - 0.25*[z(global_ls_ratio, basket mean) > 1]; missing term = 0 penalty; floor 0.25
risk_dial.z: trailing 365-day z-score, using the feature screen's lagging rules

costs.funding: perp positions settle funding at each print: cash -= signed_notional x rate (longs pay positive rates, shorts receive)

run: one continuous run per variant from start to end, starting cash 10,000 USDT; splits are reporting windows only (no reset)
benchmarks: G1 v2 selected variants (for reference only)

gate_g2_per_variant.oos_sharpe_ci: stationary block bootstrap of OOS daily returns, mean block 10 days, 2000 reps, under fees x2 and slippage x2
gate_g2_per_variant.positive_splits: net return > 0 in a majority of the 6 splits, and 2022 among them
gate_g2_per_variant.note: Max drawdown limit is 20% over the continuous 6.8-year run (G1 used 15% per one-year split). Stated before results.

after_pass: A passing variant goes to paper trading (Binance testnet or live paper) as the true holdout before any capital. 2024+ has been seen by the team in other contexts; disclosed.
